name: Global Historical Climatology Network monthly (GHCNm) Version 4
description: The Global Historical Climatology Network monthly (GHCNm) dataset provides monthly land surface climate summaries across the globe maintained by NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI). Currently in Version 4, GHCNm integrates monthly mean observations from approximately 27,000 land stations worldwide, with historical records extending back to 1701. Version 4 comprises two distinct components released in separate years: Monthly Temperature (published in 2017, DOI: 10.7289/V5XW4GTH) and Monthly Precipitation (published in 2024, DOI: 10.25921/67zp-5m03). The temperature component applies pairwise homogenization algorithms (PHA) to detect and adjust for artificial shifts caused by station relocations, instrumentation changes, and urbanization.

license.name: U.S. Government Work (17 U.S.C. 105) / Public Domain
license.notes: NOAA NCEI produced data files and homogenization algorithms are works of the United States Government in the public domain. However, because underlying station observations originate from global national meteorological services via WMO exchange, downstream users must not assume blanket commercial permission for all third-party international observations where origin countries retain domestic rights.
